meta.title: About
meta.description: EdgeRize is software for digital screens, made in Serbia, for businesses that want their space to speak.

hero.title: Software for screens, built in Serbia.
hero.subtitle: EdgeRize is built by a team that believes every screen in your space can work for you, without the hassle and without a big budget.

story.title: Why we build EdgeRize.
paragraphs: We've seen too many screens left switched off or showing the same image for years — while the menu changes by hand, promotions run late, and information goes stale. All because existing tools are expensive, complicated, or built for someone else.

We built EdgeRize to change that: a platform anyone can use to run their screens — as simple as a social media post, as powerful as a tool for a whole network of locations. Locally built, with support in your language.

items.title: Simplicity first
items.body: If it's complicated, we're not done. Every feature has to be clear at a glance.

items.title: Reliable around the clock
items.body: A frozen screen is worse than a blank one. We build it to run non-stop, even when no one's watching.

items.title: By your side
items.body: Support in your language and people who understand your business — not a ticket that waits for weeks.

items.title: No hidden costs
items.body: Fair terms and a price that doesn't change overnight. No surprises on the invoice.
